ADX 24.0으로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 판단 유보. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 0.78로 위축된 움직임은 추세 전환 신뢰도 저하. 171,300원 가격대는 20일 저가 170,000원과 5일 저가 170,000원 부근으로, 하단 볼린저밴드 165,834원과 근접. 스윙 지지선 167,300원 부근에서 지지 여부 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for the past 3 trading days. Today's RSI at 34.3 has entered oversold territory, continuing its decline from 40.3 five days ago. MACD histogram worsened from 23.6881 to -1492.9299, confirming bearish convergence. ADX at 24.0 is in the early stages of trend formation, warranting a pause in directional judgment. Volume ratio of 0.78 relative to the 5-day average indicates subdued activity, lowering confidence in trend reversal. The price of 171,300 KRW is near the 20-day low of 170,000 KRW and the 5-day low of 170,000 KRW, approaching the lower Bollinger Band at 165,834 KRW. Confirmation of support is needed around the swing support level of 167,300 KRW.
